column1: # Standby clusters for the two roster hostnames (#643). Pipe-delimited:
# The order of the rows IS the promotion order within a role. When the cluster serving a role's hostname
# fails its self-check, infra/terraform/fleet/backups.py hands the hostname to the first standby after it
# that passes, so the rows alternate regions: the next standby is never in the same region as the one
# before it, and an outage like the us-west-2 one Portland narrowly missed is skipped in one step.
# ROLE is the roster role the standby copies (roster.tsv): community stands in for attackme, admin for
# burritobot-private. A standby is built exactly as its role's primary is, profile, pids and all.
# WAVE is when it stands up, counted back from the session start the operator passes `backups.py schedule`:
#   night-before  about 18 hours out: three public standbys and all three private ones
#   six-hours     six hours out: the other nine public standbys
# Every standby lives in WIB_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT, as the roster does (account_for_role). A region other than
# WIB_HOME_REGION needs its own lab VPC first: `backups.py up` names the apply when it is missing.
# Names stay under 30 characters: the cluster module's IAM name_prefix caps at 38 with "-cluster-" appended.
